title: Bud Powell beaten at Watts in Philadelphia
summary: Hall describes the violence Powell suffered and the Philadelphia club that hired tenor players.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Well, the story was though, that he was
beaten by the police in the train station there in Philadelphia, that's the story that's been told.
Well, he's been beaten by a lot of people.
By a lot of people, yeah.
I know that he got real beat up while we were working there.
That didn't do him any good.
Watts. That was the name of the club that we were working. They hired all tenor players.
In Philly. They opened with Prez and then Jacquet and then Eddie Law Lockville. I don't know what happened after that. This was in '47, '46.
